message: Phase 1 MVP built and verified (build clean, 113/113 tests): tooling (esbuild+Vitest, manifest id teamsync, minAppVersion 1.4.0), PersonService roster with archive-preserving-history, OneOnOneService with carry-forward via pure checkbox parser extractOpenActionItems, GoalService with byte-for-byte-safe updateStatus, team dashboard fed by a pure metadata-cache model. Scaffold updated (ROUTER state, data-model schemas + carry-forward rule, stack versions, setup commands). Known follow-ups: stale services in one-on-one/goal commands after mid-session settings change; unused listActivePeople/listPersonNames; 21-day overdue threshold hardcoded; no lint.

Ollama integration (PRD Phase 3) built and verified (build clean, 150/150 tests): OllamaClient as sole AI boundary (requestUrl transport — CORS decision resolved; /api/generate non-streaming; Promise.race timeout wrapper; typed errors), additive Ollama settings with Test-connection model dropdown + free-text fallback, 'Prep 1:1 with AI' with mandatory send-preview modal, editable-draft output with citations, insert-via-service. AI disabled by default; not hooked into any core flow. Scaffold updated (ollama.md shipped-state + decisions, ROUTER state). Known follow-up: corrupt goal status frontmatter surfaces as a Notice in prep flow rather than being skipped.

Dev plans (PRD Phase 2 core) and AI Generate Overview built and verified (build clean, 191/191 tests): DevPlanService with byte-for-byte markReviewed + revision-log append and dashboard dev-plan freshness column (devPlanReviewDays default 90, at-threshold = stale, missing last_reviewed = never reviewed); 'Generate Overview' command assembles profile + last-N 1:1s + all goals + dev-plan body, send-preview then editable draft, explicit Write button create-or-replaces Overview.md (type/person/generated_at/model frontmatter; user edits win; never auto-written). AIDraftModal extracted as shared draft-modal base. Scaffold updated (data-model dev-plan + overview schemas, ollama.md shipped features, ROUTER state). Known seam: dev-plan body read via injectable readFile until DevPlanService gains a body-read method.

Added running discussion-topics queue: TopicService + per-person topics.md (type: topics), 'Add topic for discussion' and 'Open discussion topics list' commands; New 1:1 note drains the queue into the agenda and clears the list only after the note exists. The topics.md bullet list is a deliberate second sanctioned body read (user-requested file shape), documented as the Discussion Topics Rule in context/data-model.md; checkbox lines are excluded so struck topics stay in the file without re-queuing.
